jobs.title: Accessibility
jobs.description: Accessibility Statement | Cybecs Skip to content Services CISO & DPO as a Service CISO as a Service DPO as a Service GRC & Cyber Risk Compliance Adversarial Security Penetration Testing Red Team CTI as a Service CTEM as a Service - RedRok AI Security Bonfy.AI Partner Application Security - Secure Coding SOC & IR SOC & SIEM Incident Response Industries Company Speak With an Expert Home / Accessibility Statement Legal Accessibility Statement Our approach to making cybecs.com usable by as many people as possible. Our commitment Cybecs wants cybecs.com to be usable by as many people as possible, including people using assistive technology such as screen readers or keyboard-only navigation. Cybecs works to make its website accessible in accordance with Israeli Standard 5568 (the Israeli accessibility standard, based on WCAG) and targets the relevant WCAG Level AA success criteria as our technical benchmark. What we've implemented Semantic HTML structure with a single primary heading per page. A skip-to-content link and a landmark on every page. Visible keyboard-focus states on interactive elements, verified by walking the actual tab order on representative pages. ARIA labels and expanded/collapsed state on the mobile navigation menu. Support for reduced-motion preferences. Text and background colors checked against WCAG AA contrast thresholds; one sitewide gap found in muted/caption text was fixed as part of this review. The cookie-consent panel moves focus to itself when it appears and returns focus to the reopening control when closed. Required form fields carry a visible marker in addition to native browser validation, and form submission results are announced to assistive technology via a live status region. Reflow checked at a 200%-zoom-equivalent viewport width on representative pages with no horizontal scrolling or cut-off content. Where we're not there yet This Site has not undergone a formal, independent accessibility audit against a specific WCAG conformance level — the review described above was performed internally, not by an independent third-party auditor, and does not by itself constitute a compliance certification. It covered semantics, keyboard navigation and focus management, forms, images, ARIA usage, rendered color contrast, and 200%-zoom reflow on representative pages (homepage, Contact, Careers, one service page), verified using the same accessibility-tree data assistive technology relies on rather than a live screen-reader session. It did not include testing across multiple real screen-reader and browser combinations. We treat accessibility as an ongoing effort rather than a completed checklist, and we welcome reports of specific issues. Feedback If you encounter an accessibility barrier on cybecs.com, tell us what page you were on and what happened, and we'll look into it: [email protected] . Effective date: September 1, 2026. jobs.description: Vulnerability Disclosure Policy | Cybecs Skip to content Services CISO & DPO as a Service CISO as a Service DPO as a Service GRC & Cyber Risk Compliance Adversarial Security Penetration Testing Red Team CTI as a Service CTEM as a Service - RedRok AI Security Bonfy.AI Partner Application Security - Secure Coding SOC & IR SOC & SIEM Incident Response Industries Company Speak With an Expert Home / Security Disclosure Security Vulnerability Disclosure Policy How to responsibly report a security vulnerability affecting a Cybecs public system. Reporting a vulnerability If you believe you've found a security vulnerability affecting a Cybecs public system, including cybecs.com, please report it responsibly to [email protected] . Include enough detail for us to reproduce the issue: the affected URL or system, the steps you took, and what you observed. What we ask Give us a reasonable amount of time to investigate and respond before disclosing publicly. Avoid actions that could harm the availability or integrity of our systems or data, including denial-of-service testing. Avoid accessing, modifying, or exfiltrating data beyond what's necessary to demonstrate the issue. Do not attempt social engineering, phishing, or physical-access attacks against Cybecs staff or facilities. What this policy does not authorize This policy does not grant permission for intrusive testing, exploitation beyond proof-of-concept, denial-of-service testing, credential-stuffing or brute-force attacks, social engineering, or access to data belonging to other users or clients. Testing scope beyond good-faith identification and reporting of a vulnerability requires our explicit prior authorization. Our response We aim to acknowledge reports sent to [email protected] in a reasonable timeframe and to keep you informed as we investigate. We do not currently operate a paid bug bounty program.
